name: geography dash
author: mwzn
description: Time a jump off the corner of the last spike at 49.6% and skip the dash orb to avoid the dual portal and fall to the floor as the robot. Hold a tiny bit at 50.6% to hit the pad and then enter the ball portal. Click to move into the wave portal at 51.6% and then stay at the ceiling. Start holding at ~58.17% to go to the floor between the saw and slope. Release right after touching the mini portal at 58.5% to move back to the ceiling. Hold at 59.8% to get the normal gravity portal and then move back to the ceiling. Release at ~61.45%, go above the pink pad at 61.5% without touching the block and spike and then release to move to the floor. Hold back up to the ceiling at 61.7%. Move down into the middle of the screen at 74.4% and spam there to avoid a moving ceiling spike until 75.1% where you can hold back to the ceiling. Stay at the ceiling until 87%. Free to the end from there.
